findings.finding: Determinism: Plan's type closure has no HashMap/HashSet/f32/f64 (a derived Hash would not compile) and only two manual Hash impls in reach (PlanComparison, plan_parts/types.rs:266, hashes test/left/right; relations Name is not in Plan). usize/isize (lengths, enum discriminants) are written as 8 LE bytes (types.rs write_usize/write_isize), ints LE, str via std's write(bytes)+0xff, Vec length-prefixed, so the bytes are prefix-free and the same on every platform for one toolchain. std's default write_str/write_length_prefix and the derive's discriminant hashing are not a stable contract across Rust releases: a toolchain bump can change every identity, which only rebuilds the store (safe direction).
